name: academic-revision-checklist
description: Reader-first revision of academic English (dissertation chapters, abstracts, papers, defense slides). Finds the sentences a first-time reader stops at, fixes them in the author's voice, and turns each fix into a rule checked across the whole document. 66 checks from 60+ revision rounds of one HCI dissertation, a 16-item quick list, reading protocols, and a script that lists candidates for the mechanical checks. Use when revising or checking academic writing, when a text reads like AI, or when one reader comment should be applied everywhere. 修改或检查英文学术写作（博士论文、摘要、期刊论文、答辩讲稿）：找出第一次读的人会卡住的句子，按作者的口吻改，再把每一处修改变成规则查全文。
